args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(mthincome) as has_mthincome, COUNT(debincratio) as has_debincratio, COUNT(liqassets) as has_liqassets, COUNT(bankaccbal) as has_bankaccbal, COUNT(savamount) as has_savamount FROM employment_and_income e JOIN expenses_and_assets ex ON e.emplcoreref = ex.expemplref;

SELECT 
  e.emplcoreref,
  e.debincratio,
  e.mthincome,
  ex.liqassets,
  ex.bankaccbal,
  ex.savamount,
  LEAST(1.0, 0.3 * (1 - e.debincratio)) as comp1,
  LEAST(1.0, 0.3 * (ex.liqassets / (e.mthincome * 6))) as comp2,
  LEAST(1.0, 0.2 * (ex.bankaccbal / (e.mthincome * 3))) as comp3,
  LEAST(1.0, 0.2 * (ex.savamount / (e.mthincome * 12))) as comp4
FROM employment_and_income e
JOIN expenses_and_assets ex ON e.emplcoreref = ex.expemplref
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  e.emplcoreref,
  ROUND(CAST(
    LEAST(1.0, 0.3 * (1 - e.debincratio)) +
    LEAST(1.0, 0.3 * (ex.liqassets / (e.mthincome * 6))) +
    LEAST(1.0, 0.2 * (ex.bankaccbal / (e.mthincome * 3))) +
    LEAST(1.0, 0.2 * (ex.savamount / (e.mthincome * 12)))
  AS numeric), 4) as fsi
FROM employment_and_income e
JOIN expenses_and_assets ex ON e.emplcoreref = ex.expemplref
LIMIT 5;

ALTER TABLE employment_and_income ADD COLUMN fsi numeric;

DO $$
DECLARE
  rec RECORD;
BEGIN
  FOR rec IN 
    SELECT e.emplcoreref, e.debincratio, e.mthincome, ex.liqassets, ex.bankaccbal, ex.savamount
    FROM employment_and_income e
    JOIN expenses_and_assets ex ON e.emplcoreref = ex.expemplref
  LOOP
    UPDATE employment_and_income
    SET fsi = LEAST(1.0, 0.3 * (1 - rec.debincratio)) +
              LEAST(1.0, 0.3 * (rec.liqassets / (rec.mthincome * 6))) +
              LEAST(1.0, 0.2 * (rec.bankaccbal / (rec.mthincome * 3))) +
              LEAST(1.0, 0.2 * (rec.savamount / (rec.mthincome * 12)))
    WHERE emplcoreref = rec.emplcoreref;
  END LOOP;
END $$;
